title: Fire truck with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ladder -->
  <rect x='18' y='20' width='52' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='18' y='28' width='52' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='22' y='18' width='3' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#c0c0c0'/>
  <rect x='36' y='18' width='3' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#c0c0c0'/>
  <rect x='50' y='18' width='3' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#c0c0c0'/>
  <rect x='64' y='18' width='3' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#c0c0c0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='14' y='38' width='62' height='30' rx='6' fill='#ff3b3b'/>
  <!-- cab -->
  <rect x='58' y='34' width='26' height='34' rx='6' fill='#d42a2a'/>
  <!-- windshield -->
  <rect x='64' y='40' width='16' height='12' rx='3' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <!-- windshield shine -->
  <rect x='66' y='42' width='5' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#d8f6ff'/>
  <!-- light bar -->
  <rect x='62' y='30' width='18' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#ff5555'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#5599ff'/>
  <!-- face eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='48' r='6' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='6' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='49' r='3' fill='#283040'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='49' r='3' fill='#283040'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='48' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='48' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M32 56 Q42 66 58 56' stroke='#ffe680' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#ff8c8c' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#ff8c8c' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- front bumper -->
  <rect x='80' y='58' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='70' r='10' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='70' r='5' fill='#b8b8c8'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='70' r='2' fill='#8a8a9a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='70' r='10' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='70' r='5' fill='#b8b8c8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='70' r='2' fill='#8a8a9a'/>
  <!-- wheel highlights -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='67' r='2' fill='#9090a0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='67' r='2' fill='#9090a0' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
